<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
def curBR():
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rr,cc=b[0]
        if n['pixels']==36 and 36<=rr<60 and 36<=cc<60:
            out[((rr-36)//8,(cc-36)//8)]=n['color']
    return out
BR = curBR()
def pat(rows):  # rows: list of 3 strings, '.'=center
    d={}
    for r in range(3):
        for c in range(3):
            if rows[r][c]=='.': continue
            d[(r,c)] = 'R' if rows[r][c]=='R' else 'b'
    return d
cands = [
 ("TR(copy top)",   ["bRb","R.R","bRb"]),
 ("rot180(TL)",     ["RRb","b.R","bRb"]),
 ("BL(copy left)",  ["Rbb","R.R","bbR"]),
 ("TL(copy diag)",  ["bRb","R.b","bRR"]),
 ("mirror(BL)",     ["bbR","R.R","Rbb"]),
 ("rot90cw(TL)",    ["bRb","R.R","Rbb"]),
 ("own mini",       ["Rbb","R.R","Rbb"]),
 ("allR",           ["RRR","R.R","RRR"]),
]
def center(r,c): return (39+8*r, 39+8*c)
def state():
    return curBR()
def matches(target):
    s=state()
    return all(s.get(k)==v for k,v in target.items())
total=0
for name,rows in cands:
    t=pat(rows)
    s=state()
    toggles=[(r,c) for (r,c),v in t.items() if s.get((r,c))!=v]
    for (r,c) in toggles:
        total+=1
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':center(r,c)[0],'col':center(r,c)[1]}])
        res=last_action_result
        if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('run_complete') or res.get('game_over'):
            print("CLEARED at candidate", name, "after", total, "cascade clicks")
            result={'cleared':name,'total':total}
            raise SystemExit
    if matches(t):
        print("candidate", name, "reached (not cleared yet)")
    else:
        print("candidate", name, "NOT reached?! state=", state())
print("cascade exhausted, total clicks", total, "final state", state())
result={'exhausted':True,'total':total}
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
def curBR():
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rr,cc=b[0]
        if n['pixels']==36 and 36<=rr<60 and 36<=cc<60:
            out[((rr-36)//8,(cc-36)//8)]=n['color']
    return out
BR = curBR()
def pat(rows):  # rows: list of 3 strings, '.'=center
    d={}
    for r in range(3):
        for c in range(3):
            if rows[r][c]=='.': continue
            d[(r,c)] = 'R' if rows[r][c]=='R' else 'b'
    return d
cands = [
 ("TR(copy top)",   ["bRb","R.R","bRb"]),
 ("rot180(TL)",     ["RRb","b.R","bRb"]),
 ("BL(copy left)",  ["Rbb","R.R","bbR"]),
 ("TL(copy diag)",  ["bRb","R.b","bRR"]),
 ("mirror(BL)",     ["bbR","R.R","Rbb"]),
 ("rot90cw(TL)",    ["bRb","R.R","Rbb"]),
 ("own mini",       ["Rbb","R.R","Rbb"]),
 ("allR",           ["RRR","R.R","RRR"]),
]
def center(r,c): return (39+8*r, 39+8*c)
def state():
    return curBR()
def matches(target):
    s=state()
    return all(s.get(k)==v for k,v in target.items())
total=0
for name,rows in cands:
    t=pat(rows)
    s=state()
    toggles=[(r,c) for (r,c),v in t.items() if s.get((r,c))!=v]
    for (r,c) in toggles:
        total+=1
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':center(r,c)[0],'col':center(r,c)[1]}])
        res=last_action_result
        if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('run_complete') or res.get('game_over'):
            print("CLEARED at candidate", name, "after", total, "cascade clicks")
            result={'cleared':name,'total':total}
            raise SystemExit
    if matches(t):
        print("candidate", name, "reached (not cleared yet)")
    else:
        print("candidate", name, "NOT reached?! state=", state())
print("cascade exhausted, total clicks", total, "final state", state())
result={'exhausted':True,'total':total}
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
